ashley_cs: Quick sync — Northbridge renewal in 4 weeks. We need a tidy SLO evidence bundle and to confirm whether they'll get a latency/uplift credit. Who can own the evidence collection?
rafael_cso: I can pull the uptime ledger + traces. Clarify window: contract says 'monthly' but they asked for a 30‑day lookback that ends on billing cut. Is that right?
ashley_cs: Yes, 30-day lookback ending 2026-03-31. Contracted uptime target: 99.95% (monthly). Latency SLOs: p95 < 120ms, p99 < 450ms per customer route.
jamie_se: Noted — we saw KV cache evictions in early March that cause p99 spikes on /api/generate. Will add traces. Which routes do we include for SLO?
ashley_cs: Main routes only: /api/generate, /api/embeddings, /api/chat. Exclude internal health checks.
priya_prod: For customer messaging: do we propose a one-off goodwill credit or follow the contract credit ladder? legal prefers contract-first unless impact >10% of monthly bill.
rafael_cso: I pulled the export — uptime-bot queued an export (attached). uptime-bot: export ready -> /exports/northbridge_march_2026.csv :file_folder: 
ashley_cs: Screenshot of contract clause: ``Monthly Uptime < 99.9% => 5% credit; <99.5% => 10% credit; <99.0% => 20% credit``. Use that as baseline.
jamie_se: I'll attach traces and a short root-cause note about cache eviction + noisy background jobs.
priya_prod: Also capture enablement notes — Northbridge reported confusion on model pinning behavior; can we add a 30-min runbook walkthrough as part of comms?
ashley_cs: Good idea. Offer a 30min walkthrough + short FAQ. Add to action items.
rafael_cso: Action list: 1) I will create SLO evidence bundle (ledger CSV + uptime graphs) by EOD 3/18. 2) @jamie_se attach traces + RCA. 3) @priya_prod draft customer comms & walkthrough invite. 4) @ashley_cs confirm final credit number and approvals.
jamie_se: Will attach traces and a short timeline. Also adding a snippet of query I used to compute p99: 
```
SELECT percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS p99
FROM request_logs
WHERE route IN ('/api/generate','/api/embeddings','/api/chat')
  AND timestamp >= '2026-03-01'
  AND timestamp < '2026-04-01';
```
priya_prod: Draft comms ready for review: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/northbridge-slo-comms-draft — PTAL once attachments are in.
ashley_cs: If observed uptime <99.9% we default to contractual credit. If impact suggests broader service change, we escalate to sales/legal.
rafael_cso: Uploading evidence bundle now. Link: https://s3.redwood.ai/northbridge/evidence/2026-03.zip (public link redacted)
uptime-bot: ledger export: 3896543260 - 30d uptime 99.87% (downtime 0.13%) :eyes:
ashley_cs: Ok — 99.87% triggers 5% credit per contract. I'll draft the credit calc and approval note.
priya_prod: I'll schedule the 30-min walkthrough — propose next Tue 10am PT.
ashley_cs: Great — next steps done. Thanks team :thumbsup:
